Over these past two years, have there been any periods lasting more than a couple of months where you felt like your usual self again?

Oh, dear... let me think on that. I... well, no, I don't believe so. Not for a whole couple of months at a time, anyway. 

I mean, I do have good days! I really try my best to keep a smile on, and I certainly don't want you to think I'm just sitting around moping all the time. But as far as really feeling like my old self for a long stretch... no, I don't think I have. I'm so sorry, I hope that's not a bad answer. I just haven't quite been able to shake it off completely.
